findings.evidence: `rg` shows four geometric commutation lemmas in `CubeGenerator.lean`: `lowerFace_lowerFace_comm`, `upperFace_upperFace_comm`, `lowerFace_upperFace_comm`, and `upperFace_lowerFace_comm` at lines 364, 377, 391, 404, but `CubeFaceExponent.lean` adds only three exponent lemmas at lines 48, 66, and 85.
findings.fix: Add `characteristicUpperFaceExponent_add_lowerFace_comm`, e.g. `upper C v + lower (C.upperFace v hv) w = lower C w + upper (C.lowerFace w hw) v`, derivable from `characteristicLowerFaceExponent_add_upperFace_comm P k C hw hv hne.symm`.
findings.issue: The PR pairs exponent sums with `lowerFace_upperFace_comm` but omits the symmetric `upperFace_lowerFace_comm` exponent theorem, leaving the existing four-corner face API only partially covered.

summary: The exponent-square API stops short of the natural level set by the existing four face-commutation lemmas: it adds only one named mixed exponent theorem, while the bundled cube API has two mixed codimension-two corners.
